properties.name: weakcrypto:config
properties.value: skill pq-crypto, 2 scouts, max iterations 400, build bbcd802706e4

components.name: random_dummy (external PRNG hook for RSA padding)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party RC4 (Arcfour) stream cipher, shipped as a selectable SCAL descriptor (scal/scal_arcfour.c) — note the key-size descriptor permits keys from 8 to 2040 bits (KS_TYPE_ARG_RANGE, KS_INT(8)..KS_INT(2040), scal/scal_arcfour.c:31): an 8-bit RC4 key is selectable through this registration, on top of RC4's classical keystream biases. Classically broken independent of PQ; D rating stands. Replace with AES-256-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party SHA-1 implementation (sha1/sha1.c) consumed by hmac-sha1 and the test harness, and registered as a selectable hash in the abstraction layer (hfal/hfal_sha1.c:35, sha1_desc) — so any HFAL client can select SHA-1 by descriptor. Collision-broken classically; quantum collision search needs only ~2^53 work — migrate to SHA-384 (already shipped in this library, sha2/sha384.c). D rating stands.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 as shipped in this crypto library: core implementation (md5/md5.c), HMAC-MD5 wrapper (hmac-md5/hmac-md5.c) and known-answer self-tests. First-party API surface — any linked application can invoke it; collision-broken digest, migrate to SHA-384 per the object's remediation.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test harness for the library's HMAC-MD5 (hmac-md5/hmac-md5.c): nessie/interactive/self-test runs that genuinely call the MAC. MD5-based MAC is classically broken (collision-resistance collapse) independent of PQ concerns; the D rating stands. Shipped with the library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Camellia-128 as shipped: core implementation (camellia/), bcal abstraction-layer glue (bcal/bcal_camellia128.c/.h) and self-test. Symmetric cipher, Grover-only exposure, but outside the NIST-approved set — CNSA 2.0 prefers AES-256.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CMAC over the bcal block-cipher abstraction layer (bcal/bcal-cmac.c): a generic CBC-MAC-based MAC any linked application can run over any bcal-registered cipher; exercised by the CMAC verification suite (test_src/cmacvs.c) and AES-CMAC self-tests (main-aes-test.c). Block-cipher MAC; Grover-only exposure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party RSA-OAEP key-transport implementation (rsa_encrypt_oaep/rsa_decrypt_oaep in rsa/rsaes_oaep.c, incl. header API) plus live calls in the library's test program. Quantum-vulnerable key transport: ciphertexts recorded today become readable once a CRQC exists (harvest-now-decrypt-later). Library implementation — changeable here, but migration to ML-KEM-768 is a redesign of the call site (KEM/DEM), not a parameter swap.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-224 implementation (sha2/sha224.c) plus hfal glue (referenced by the ECDSA harness's hash selector). 224-bit SHA-2 truncation = 112-bit collision security; classically acceptable, below the CNSA 2.0 384-bit digest requirement.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA-1 known-answer test harness (RFC 2202 vectors) driving the library's hmac-sha1 module; the SHA-1 implementation itself is a separate inventory object (hmac-sha1/hmac-sha1.c, sha1/sha1.c). Library ships this MAC path; 160-bit tag, collision-broken inner hash — migrate to HMAC-SHA-384.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA self-test harness (main-ecdsa-test.c) exercising this library's own ECDSA implementation (ecdsa/ecdsa_sign.c over ecc/ point arithmetic) on NIST P-192 (nist_p192.h), with a runtime-selectable hash via hfal descriptors (sha1/224/256/384/512) and Noekeon-PRNG-backed random8() as the k source. ECDSA signatures are broken by Shor; migrate to ML-DSA-65. Changeable here — first-party code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's Keccak/SHA-3 module: keccak/keccak.c implements Keccak-f1600 (keccak_round, keccak_f1600, keccak_nextBlock/lastBlock), and hfal/hfal_keccak.c registers all four variants (Keccak-224/256/384/512) as selectable hfdesc_t descriptors in the hash abstraction layer — this is the shipped SHA-3-family API surface. A- rating: PQ-acceptable (Grover halves collision resistance; Keccak-256 still ~128-bit). Keep as the PQ-preferred hash going forward.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 as shipped: key schedule, enc/dec variants (aes/aes128_enc.c, aes128_dec.c, keyexp), bcal glue and self-tests. Grover halves the 128-bit key to a 64-bit quantum margin — not urgent, but below CNSA 2.0's AES-256 requirement.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE (SHA-3 finalist) implementation (blake/blake_large.c etc.) plus self-test; Grover-only exposure, hash primitive. Part of the library's shipped API surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 shipped twice (sha2/sha256.c and sha256/sha256.c), registered in the hash abstraction layer (hfal/hfal_sha256.c:35, sha256_desc), consumed by hmac-sha256 and the entropy collector entropium/entropium.c (SHA-256 conditioning over its 512-bit pool). The sha2 module also provides SHA-224, SHA-384 and SHA-512 siblings — 384/512 reported as separate findings. A- rating: PQ-acceptable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test harness for the library's HMAC-SHA-256 implementation (hmac-sha256/hmac-sha256.c): nessie + self-test runs that genuinely call the MAC. The library ships HMAC-SHA-256 as a supported primitive; HMAC itself is quantum-resistant, SHA-256 is PQ-acceptable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256 as shipped: key schedule, enc/dec variants plus self-tests. Matches CNSA 2.0's symmetric requirement; Grover leaves a 128-bit quantum margin.
